verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework, so injecting per-caller context at call time is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents passing dynamic variables, call-time arguments or per-caller context into a bot session. The telephony webhook, dev-runner and Flows function items describe how sessions start and how functions call external APIs. None of them describes personalizing a conversation with injected variables.
